tasks.title: Set up Dynamic Route
tasks.description: Set up the Next.js project and configure the dynamic route for listing detail pages.
tasks.details:
1.  Ensure Next.js project is initialized.
2.  Create the dynamic route file: `app/src/app/listings/[id]/page.tsx`.
3.  Configure the route to accept a listing ID (or slug) as a parameter.
4.  Set up basic page structure with a placeholder for content.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the route is accessible and renders a basic page structure. Check for correct parameter handling.

subtasks.title: Initialize Next.js Project
subtasks.description: Initialize the Next.js project if not already done.
subtasks.details: Ensure a Next.js project is set up and ready for development.

subtasks.title: Create Route File and Configure Parameter
subtasks.description: Create the route file and configure the dynamic route parameter.
subtasks.details: Create the `app/src/app/listings/[id]/page.tsx` file and configure it to accept a listing ID (or slug) as a parameter.

subtasks.title: Add Placeholder Content and Verify Route
subtasks.description: Add basic placeholder content and verify the route works.
subtasks.details: Set up a basic page structure with placeholder content and test the route to ensure it's accessible and the parameter is correctly handled.

tasks.title: Define TypeScript Interfaces for Listing Data
tasks.description: Define TypeScript interfaces for listing data fetched from Sanity CMS.
tasks.details:
1.  Analyze the Sanity CMS schema to identify data fields for listings.
2.  Create TypeScript interfaces (e.g., `Listing`, `Amenity`, `EcoFeature`) to represent the data structure.
3.  Ensure type safety across components using these interfaces.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the interfaces accurately reflect the Sanity schema. Ensure type checking is enforced in components using the interfaces.

subtasks.title: Analyze Sanity CMS Schema
subtasks.description: Analyze the Sanity CMS schema to identify data fields relevant to listings.
subtasks.details: Examine the Sanity schema to understand the structure of listing data, including core fields like title, description, and location.

subtasks.title: Create Core Listing Interfaces
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces for the core listing data fields.
subtasks.details: Define TypeScript interfaces (e.g., `Listing`) to represent the core listing data structure, ensuring type safety.

subtasks.title: Create Related Data Interfaces
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces for related data, such as amenities and eco-features.
subtasks.details: Define interfaces (e.g., `Amenity`, `EcoFeature`) to represent related data, ensuring type safety for components using these interfaces.

tasks.title: Implement GROQ Queries for Data Fetching
tasks.description: Implement GROQ queries to fetch listing details, images, coordinates, and reviews from Sanity CMS.
tasks.details:
1.  Install the Sanity client library.
2.  Write GROQ queries to fetch all necessary data for a listing based on its ID (or slug).
3.  Implement error handling for data fetching.
4.  Create a function to fetch data from Sanity, using the GROQ queries.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the GROQ queries by fetching data for a known listing. Verify that all required data fields are retrieved correctly. Check error handling.

subtasks.title: Install the Sanity client library
subtasks.description: Install the necessary Sanity client library to interact with the Sanity CMS.
subtasks.details: Use npm or yarn to install the Sanity client library.

subtasks.title: Write GROQ query to fetch basic listing details
subtasks.description: Create a GROQ query to retrieve essential listing information (e.g., title, description).
subtasks.details: Craft a GROQ query to fetch basic listing details based on ID or slug.

subtasks.title: Write GROQ query to fetch images
subtasks.description: Develop a GROQ query to fetch images associated with a listing.
subtasks.details: Create a GROQ query to retrieve image data, including URLs and alt text.

subtasks.title: Write GROQ query to fetch coordinates and reviews
subtasks.description: Construct a GROQ query to fetch listing coordinates and reviews.
subtasks.details: Develop a GROQ query to retrieve location data and review information.

subtasks.title: Implement error handling and create a data fetching function
subtasks.description: Implement error handling and create a function to fetch data from Sanity using the GROQ queries.
subtasks.details: Create a function to fetch data from Sanity, incorporating error handling for potential issues during data retrieval.

tasks.title: Build Hero Section
tasks.description: Build the hero section with the main image and listing name.
tasks.details:
1.  Use `next/image` for the hero image, implementing responsive image loading and blur placeholders.
2.  Fetch the listing name and tagline from the fetched data.
3.  Style the hero section with a large image and overlaid text.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the hero image loads correctly and is responsive. Check that the listing name and tagline are displayed accurately. Ensure proper alt text is used.

subtasks.description: Implement the hero image using `next/image`, including responsive image loading and blur placeholders.
subtasks.details: Use `next/image` component to display the hero image. Configure responsive image sizes and implement blur placeholders for improved loading experience.

tasks.title: Conduct Accessibility Testing and Fix Issues
tasks.description: Conduct accessibility testing and fix issues.
tasks.details:
1.  Perform accessibility testing using automated tools and manual checks.
2.  Address any identified accessibility issues, such as keyboard navigation, alt text, and color contrast.
tasks.testStrategy: Use accessibility testing tools to identify and fix issues. Manually test keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility.

subtasks.title: Perform Automated Accessibility Testing
subtasks.description: Utilize automated accessibility testing tools (e.g., Lighthouse, Axe) to identify potential issues.
subtasks.details: Run automated tests and document the findings, including specific elements and violations.

subtasks.title: Conduct Manual Accessibility Checks
subtasks.description: Manually test for accessibility issues, focusing on keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, and color contrast.
subtasks.details: Verify keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility (using a screen reader like VoiceOver or NVDA), and color contrast compliance.

subtasks.title: Fix Identified Accessibility Issues
subtasks.description: Address all identified accessibility issues based on the testing results.
subtasks.details: Implement fixes for issues such as missing alt text, incorrect color contrast, and keyboard navigation problems. Ensure all fixes meet WCAG guidelines.
